edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the indexed account whose balance is debited in transfer.
msg.sender keys the allowed mapping write in approve.
msg.sender indexes the spender allowance that transferFrom decrements.
msg.sender is written into allowed and forwarded as the callback 'from' argument.
msg.sender must equal newOwner for acceptOwnership to proceed.
constructor assigns msg.sender to owner, establishing the privileged account.
transferOwnership writes the caller-supplied address into newOwner under onlyOwner.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner into owner, changing the privileged account.
acceptOwnership clears newOwner to address(0) after promotion.
constructor sets owner, the root of all authorization in the contract.
constructor computes and stores _totalSupply from decimals.
constructor credits the entire supply to balances[owner].
transfer debits and credits entries in the balances mapping.
approve writes the allowance into the allowed mapping.
transferFrom mutates source and destination balances.
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender].
allowance reads the allowed mapping for owner/spender pair.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
totalSupply reads _totalSupply and subtracts the address(0) balance.
approveAndCall writes the allowance before performing the external callback.
approveAndCall performs an external call to the spender contract before returning success.
The spender's receiveApproval can re-enter the token contract, whose state is only partially finalized.
transferAnyERC20Token invokes transfer on a caller-supplied token contract.
The external token contract executes arbitrary code and may call back into this contract.
transfer performs sub/add on balances, overflow/underflow guarded by SafeMath requires.
transferFrom performs sub/add on balances and allowed, guarded by SafeMath requires.
transferAnyERC20Token sends the rescued tokens to the stored owner address.

normalization_plan.reason: Recipient parameter exists only to feed the balances write inside transfer; fold into the transfer function node.
Amount parameter exists only as the operand of the SafeMath sub/add inside transfer; fold into transfer.
Spender parameter only indexes allowed[msg.sender][spender] in approve; fold into approve.
Token amount parameter only sets the allowance value in approve; fold into approve.
Source address parameter only indexes balances and allowed in transferFrom; fold into transferFrom.
Destination address parameter only indexes balances in transferFrom; fold into transferFrom.
Amount parameter only feeds the SafeMath operations in transferFrom; fold into transferFrom.
Spender parameter drives both the allowance write and the external callback target; fold into approveAndCall.
Token amount parameter sets the allowance and is forwarded to the callback; fold into approveAndCall.
Arbitrary data is passed straight into the external receiveApproval call; fold into the external call operation.
Token address parameter is the target of the external transfer call; fold into the external call operation.
Amount parameter only feeds the rescue transfer; fold into transferAnyERC20Token.
Candidate owner parameter only writes the newOwner state variable; fold into transferOwnership.
